newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE certified coffee stocks fall to 1,401 lots.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE certified coffee stocks fall to 1,401 lots.

text.p: London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) certified coffee stocks fell to 1,401 five-tonne lots in October from 1,591 lots in September, traders said on Friday.
There was no immediate confirmation from LIFFE.
Traders said the news is within market expectation and is unlikely to impact prices.
But one trader said more coffee is being graded and this could result in higher stocks in November.
The stock news came after the London market closed for its midday break.
By the morning close, the benchmark January robusta coffee futures stood $7.00 down on the day at $1,425 a tonne on origin selling.

But activity was thin and traders said the market was awaiting the U.S. Green Coffee Association's October inventory data due after the close of New York trading on Friday. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
